key_insights.content: Transactions flagged on Friday afternoons have a 3x higher false-positive rate than weekday morning flags. Recommend elevated confidence threshold for Friday 14:00-18:00 window.
Merchants in category code 5411 (grocery stores) generate the highest volume of sub-$50 transactions. These are consistently allowed with no drift from baseline.
The March 2025 drift event was caused by a change in upstream event schema that temporarily caused all transactions to appear as write operations. Resolved by schema version pinning.
The $10,000 threshold generates approximately 6% false positives on first flag. Members who dispute flags within 24 hours are correct 82% of the time.
